# arcane_api_resource (Resource)

Manages an Arcane API object from a YAML manifest. The provider adds the `app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: terraform` label when it creates or updates the object, unless the manifest sets that label.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cluster scoped api resource
resource "arcane_api_resource" "test" {
  manifest = <<-YAML
apiVersion: bluechip.pubg.io/v1
kind: Vendor
metadata:
  name: test-vendor
spec:
  codeName: NCP
  displayName: test
  shortName: dd
  regions:
  - AP-NORTHEAST-222
YAML
}

# Namespace scoped api resource
resource "arcane_api_resource" "test_namespaced" {
  manifest = <<-YAML
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.arcane.pubg.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  annotations:
    foo: bar
  labels: {}
  name: arcane-provider-test
  namespace: default
rules:
- apiGroups:
  - bluechip.pubg.io
  resources:
  - ingameimages
  verbs:
  - '*'
- apiGroups:
  - ""
  resources:
  - namespaces
  verbs:
  - get
  - create
YAML
}

# Leave fields that a controller changes out of drift detection, and wait until the object is ready
resource "arcane_api_resource" "with_wait" {
  ignore_fields = [
    "spec.replicas",
    "metadata.annotations[\"example.io/last-synced\"]",
  ]

  manifest = <<-YAML
apiVersion: example.pubg.io/v1
kind: Worker
metadata:
  name: worker
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 2
YAML

  wait {
    condition {
      type   = "Ready"
      status = "True"
    }
    field {
      key   = "status.phase"
      value = "Running"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) YAML manifest of the resource. Changing apiVersion, kind, metadata.name or metadata.namespace forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `ignore_fields` (List of String) Field paths to leave out of drift detection, such as `spec.replicas`, `webhooks[0].caBundle` or `metadata.annotations["example.io/hash"]`. A path also covers every field under it. On update, the provider sends the live value of these fields instead of the manifest value.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `wait` (Block, Optional) Conditions to wait for after the object is created or updated, bounded by the create and update timeouts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--wait))

### Read-Only

- `drift` (String) Fields written in the manifest whose live value differs, one per line. Empty when they match. A non-empty value makes the next plan update the object back to the manifest. Property subresources reported by API discovery, such as `status`, are not compared because controllers write them.
- `id` (String) API path of the resource
- `object` (String) Resource object returned by the API server

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedblock--wait"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wait`

Optional:

- `condition` (Block List) An entry in `status.conditions` that must have this status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--wait--condition))
- `field` (Block List) A field that must have this value. Values that are not strings are compared as JSON. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--wait--field))

<a id="nestedblock--wait--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wait.condition`

Required:

- `status` (String) Condition status, such as True.
- `type` (String) Condition type, such as Ready.


<a id="nestedblock--wait--field"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wait.field`

Required:

- `key` (String) Field path, such as status.phase.
- `value` (String) Value to wait for.

Optional:

- `value_type` (String) How to compare the value: eq (default) or regex.
